title: pv.normalize_terminology
description: Free-text terminology normalization suggestion against a versioned terminology table. Always returned as a suggestion with a confidence value — DDD domain_model.md §8 requires this never be silently applied. Provisional (20b scope).
authorization_requirement: Caller must present a pv_intake graph-run credential.

idempotency.guarantee: Pure function of input text and terminology_table_version.

source_text.description: Raw free-text term(s) from case intake, in any supported source language.

terminology_source.description: e.g. MedDRA version reference — the versioned table this suggestion came from.

applied.description: Always false. This field exists specifically so a caller cannot construct a response that claims the suggestion was applied — the schema fixes the value, it is not merely a default (same pattern as evidence_retrieve's absent scope field: don't rely on the caller setting it correctly).

errors.graph_response: return suggestions: [], let the agent flag for human normalization
